testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.ai.OpenRouterPromptTests

testcase.name: auto mode fails over across free models on 429, garbage and bad JSON()
status offers only free text models, router first, and never exposes the key()
only free listed models can be chosen, mock is always available, an explicit model is not silently replaced()
each user has a daily allowance of real-AI prompts, the simulator is exempt()
when every model fails the user gets a clear UNSUPPORTED answer, nothing is stored and no upstream text leaks()
an invalid proposal from the model (unknown component, invalid props) is rejected without storing anything()
an AI answer in a code fence is applied through the normal validated pipeline and stored as a version()
